description: A really enjoyable, evasion intensive deck. I've only played with it for a few weeks and no tournaments, so any comments would be helpful.
strategy:
While I admit this deck is not very original (see Angeleno Consoli's QMC, I figuered that by me posting it and the year that has gone by since he posted it, new strategies have emerged. I haven't seen anyone's deck that has looked like this (sorry if yours is similar) so I thought I'd post it.

First Turn

A first turn flaip is entirly possible with this deck. As several of the characters deploy for free or have their deploy cost modified. About half of the time a first turn flip is acheived. The Outrider and Dash should be dropped to Bespin and you should drop any characters without fear because you should have at least a barrier, trap, or path in your hand. Remember, if a first turn flip is acheived, look through your force pile before you end your turn, because KTEOF lets you look through at anytime, not just control phase.

Mid-Game

You should be able to get any card you want because of KTEOF and For Luck(v). Drop power characters to protects Thryss and you should keep a stranglehold on Bespin and The West Gallery. Massive drain are very much a possibility and so is massive retrival.

Card Choices

Arcona-Pullable with Out of Nowhere, it is an easy way to flip first turn withou fear.

Figrin Dan-Cheap Character for first turn flip. Hey, who doesn't love extra retrival?

Weather Vane-When it works, it's great,and it's support cards have very high destiny.

For Luck- anti-Senate, Anti-Invasion, Anti-CCT, and Anti-Walkers. It may not seem like much, but it helps temendously.

Landing Claw-Anti-SYCFA and space CCT. It's a big pain to your opponent. Put it on the Falcon because Ghhk combo and Flagship (v) are making the rounds.

Nar Shadda Wind Chimes/Out of Somewhere-Pulls my arcona, and the react deployment is invaluable.

Alter(coruscant)-Anti-Senate. It being lost doesnt matter because I will just alter something during my control phase and get it back with Luke (v) or CCC

Match-Ups

CCT- Ver good Matchup. More than enough space to hold bespin, and the Darkside will have a hard time getting a beat on any character. Eventually the massive retrival will do them in.

SYCFA-Get honor out. And use Landing Claw and the point that he is hurting you the most. Also, try to Alter all of his FWKTIL's. It helps ;).

Senate-This deck has alot of tech against senate. Justy cancel his force drain canceler, and avoid the beats.

Invasion-Ignore Naboo. Concentrate on your own stuff and you should be fine.

I don't have anymore matchups, so I need some help.

Any help would be appreciated,

Andrew
